IBM.rationale: IBM is in a severe fundamental deterioration. Q2 2026 results showed only 1% YoY revenue growth (vs. 5%+ guidance), with Infrastructure revenue declining 7% and Transaction Processing revenue down 9%. The Z mainframe shortfall was catastrophic, with CEO Krishna admitting 'numerous large deals failed to close' and 'we did not adapt and move quickly enough.' The stock plummeted 25% on July 14, 2026, erasing $68 billion in market capitalization. Multiple securities investigations are underway. The company revised full-year revenue growth guidance down to 4%-5% from 5%+.
